name: kia_uvo
description: A Home Assistant HACS integration that supports Kia Connect(Uvo) and Hyundai Bluelink. The integration supports the EU, Canada and the USA.

# [4.0.0](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/compare/v3.22.0...v4.0.0) (2026-11-08)


### Bug Fixes

* **binary_sensor:** keep the plug entity created for BEV/PHEV ([#2071](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2071)) ([5567d44](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/5567d44050c835a445ce81fc7a70dbbcc58551f7)), closes [kia_uvo#2069](https://github.com/kia_uvo/issues/2069) [Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api#1545](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api/issues/1545) [#1545](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/1545)
* **climate:** support native temperature properties ([#2033](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2033)) ([e8106e5](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/e8106e58fa24fe7c3df188f74f81e2db562a608b))
* **coord:** raise UpdateFailed instead of re-auth when every vehicle poll fails auth ([#2049](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2049)) ([9d32b62](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/9d32b629b74c7223257036396932dbe4ff130b30)), closes [#2028](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2028)
* **coord:** replace deprecated device_registry.async_get_device ([#2084](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2084)) ([20e191a](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/20e191a48572d7943b309e5c8d5bf5ffacac0296)), closes [#2026](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2026) [#2083](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2083)
* **deps:** bump hyundai_kia_connect_api 5.1.0 → 5.1.1 ([#2086](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2086)) ([d3d7d2d](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/d3d7d2d017b0bad3a2f86b7db058ad379263cf6b)), closes [Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api#1565](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api/issues/1565) [Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api#1567](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api/issues/1567) [Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api#1564](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api/issues/1564) [Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api#1550](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api/issues/1550)
* chain setup errors and use lazy log formatting ([#2058](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2058)) ([fd56abd](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/fd56abd111872fa11b1e6ecd0dd3f1c27a72ded3))


### Features

* **config_flow:** hint on EU passwords longer than 20 characters ([#1979](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/1979)) ([#2052](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/issues/2052)) ([704f6a5](https://github.com/Hyundai-Kia-Connect/kia_uvo/commit/704f6a5efb920e6c49eea0e39e74971ddb8f0b9f))
